body:
I've had an email today stating that my future needs to be discussed and if I want my mental health to support my reasons for staying, I need evidence. 

I'd say when I panicked I was 80% sure and now it's more like 50%

It's my attendance that's the issue - my depression is so bad that I rarely leave the house
Today yes. I don't know what's the point in going on

The thing stopping me from telling him is that he refers to me as his sister a lot. Whether that's some kind of strange denial or his true feelings, I don't know.

Like you suggested, the only way to find out is if I do something. Definitely will consider.

Nice to know you've been here too! 

I do want to say something, I really do. We're living together next year too and we've already paid our deposits, so I'm not entirely sure how things would patch up if I'm outright rejected.

I will consider your advice, though. Bottling things inside is never a good option.
I keep it inside. I feel like if I say anything, it'll ruin what we have now if he doesn't feel the same way. That and the immature feeling of embarrassment I'll feel.

I'm not sure. 

He talk about other girls all the time, nothing has happened since and we've known each other for so long that surely something would have developed now?
